paite: Paul, Pathian deihlam a Khrist Jesu sawltak in, misiangthou Ephesa a om Khrist Jesu a miginomte kiang ah:
heading: Chibai Bukna
english: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus through the will of God, to the saints who are at Ephesus, and the faithful in Christ Jesus:

paite: Pathian i Pa leh Toupa Jesu Khrist kiang a kipan hehpihna leh khamuanna na kiang uah om hen.
english: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

paite: I Toupa Jesu Khrist Pa leh Pathian phat in om hen. Ama'n van munte ah khalam vualzawlna chiteng in eite Khrist ah ahon vualzawlta hi.
heading: Khrist A Khalam Vualzawlnate
english: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who has blessed us with every spiritual blessing in the heavenly places in Christ,

paite: Amah mai a siangthou leh dembei a om ding a leitung pian ma a eite hon tel tak bang ngei in;
english: even as he chose us in him before the foundation of the world, that we would be holy and without defect before him in love,

paite: Ama'n adeih leh atup bangbang in, eite Jesu Khrist vang a atate hi ding in, itna ziak in hon sepkhol khinta hi.
english: having predestined us for adoption as children through Jesus Christ to himself, according to the good pleasure of his desire,

paite: Huchi a it a ahon piak hehpihna thupi mahmah pahtawina i hihtheihna ding ahi.
english: to the praise of the glory of his grace, by which he freely gave us favor in the Beloved.

paite: Asisan ziak in amah ah tatkhiakna, ahehpihna hauhdan bang a i tatleknate ngaihdamna ngei i tangta ua,
english: In him we have our redemption through his blood, the forgiveness of our trespasses, according to the riches of his grace

paite: huai mah tuh ama'n eite lam ah pilna leh theihsiamna chiteng hon dimsakta a;
english: which he made to abound toward us in all wisdom and prudence,

paite: athiltup Khrist a agelkhiak bangbang in adeihlam thuguk eite ahon theisakta hi.
english: making known to us the mystery of his will, according to his good pleasure which he purposed in him

paite: Huai adeihlam thilgel bel; hunbi ahong kim chiang a, thil tengteng, van a omte leh leitung a omte Khrist ah gawmkhawm a asuktuah vek ding ahi.
english: to an administration of the fullness of the times, to sum up all things in Christ, the things in the heavens and the things on the earth, in him.

paite: Ama deihlam a lunggel bang a thil bangkim semkhepa tup bang ngei in, amah mah ah sehkholh a om in i gouluah ding i muta uhi.
english: We were also assigned an inheritance in him, having been foreordained according to the purpose of him who does all things after the counsel of his will,

paite: Koute, Khrist a ana lamen masate, athupina pahtawina ding a hing ding in sehkholh in ka na om khinta uhi.
english: to the end that we should be to the praise of his glory, we who had before hoped in Christ.

paite: Huan noute'n thutak thu, na hotdamna tanchinhoih uh ngaikhia a na gintak nung un, amah ah chiamsa Kha Siangthou a chiamteh in na omta uhi;
english: In him you also, having heard the word of the truth, the Good News of your salvation—in whom, having also believed, you were sealed with the promised Holy Spirit,

paite: huai tuh, Pathian thupina ding a tatna kim i tan mateng a i gouluah ding tang ngei ding i hi chih khamkholhna ahi.
english: who is a pledge of our inheritance, to the redemption of God’s own possession, to the praise of his glory.

paite: Huaiziak in ke'n leng Toupa Jesu a ginna na lak ua om leh misiangthoute tengteng tung a na itna uh ka zak in,
heading: Paul Thumna
english: For this cause I also, having heard of the faith in the Lord Jesus which is among you and the love which you have toward all the saints,

paite: ka thumnate ah na min uh lou in nou ziak a kipahthu gen ka tawp kei hi;
english: don’t cease to give thanks for you, making mention of you in my prayers,

paite: i Toupa Jesu Khrist Pathian, thupina Pa'n, amah theihna lam thu a pilna leh kilakna kha nou ahon piaktheihna ding in.
english: that the God of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of glory, may give to you a spirit of wisdom and revelation in the knowledge of him,

paite: Huchi a na lungsim mitte uh hihvak a hong om a, ama'n nou ahon sapna lametna bang leh misiangthoute agouluah hauhsaknate na theihna ding un.
english: having the eyes of your hearts enlightened, that you may know what is the hope of his calling, and what are the riches of the glory of his inheritance in the saints,

paite: Huan agingta eite athilhihtheihna thupina teh vual louh, huai a hatna thilhihtheihna toh asep bang zel in.
english: and what is the exceeding greatness of his power toward us who believe, according to that working of the strength of his might

paite: Hiai thilhihtheihna bel misi lak a kipan a Khrist akaihthoh a, vanmun a, ataklam a atutsak hun a,
english: which he worked in Christ when he raised him from the dead and made him to sit at his right hand in the heavenly places,

paite: lalnate, thuneihnate, thilhihtheihnate, vaihawmna tengteng tung leh tu khovel kia hilou a khovel hong tung ding nangawn a minsak chiteng tunglam pek ah akoih lai a azat mah ahi.
english: far above all rule, authority, power, dominion, and every name that is named, not only in this age, but also in that which is to come.

paite: Ama'n akhenuai ah bangkim akoih a, saptuam a bangkim tung a lutang in amah abawl a,
english: He put all things in subjection under his feet, and gave him to be head over all things for the assembly,

paite: huai saptuam apumpi ahi a, amah bangkim a bangkim hihdimpa taangchinna ahi.
english: which is his body, the fullness of him who fills all in all.
